correctness.rationale: For all p,q>=1 and all query supports, the missing-corner closure of two positive edges forbids any non-induced three-edge path; each edge of a star forest has a degree-one endpoint so selecting endpoints of positive queried edges realizes every labeling. The labeled-component exponential formula yields exp(u+v+uvz+u(exp(vz)-1-vz)+v(exp(uz)-1-uz)); a forest bound and two disjoint stars give VC=max(p,q) when min=1, p+q-2 otherwise. There are exactly 1+(2^p-1)(2^q-1) distinct concepts, giving online upper p+q-1; the e_(1,1) positive branch has p+q-2 free cells and the negative branch includes the smaller full rectangle family, yielding matching online lower. Cases p=q=1, one-row/column and empty concept checked. Independently enumerated all supports of 2x3 grid; source verify.py examined, not blindly trusted.
